propositions: Task T and story S both direct children of epic E cannot form a T depends_on S link under type-tier comparability; the resolver escalates to E depends_on S, creating an ancestor-blocking self-loop that is never validated.

Blocking-link comparability must be structural (same parent hierarchy) rather than type-based (tier matching), so cross-subtree dependencies escalate to nearest common ancestor children instead of chain root.
The redundancy guard is evaluated before promotion on the original pair, missing cases where promotion creates an ancestor-descendant edge that should be rejected.
Ancestor chains are capped at max_hops=2, truncating deep hierarchies and forcing fallback to chain root instead of correct NCA resolution.
_TYPE_TIER and tier-based comparability functions are dead code once structural resolution replaces type-tier logic and can be safely deleted.
